name: developer.context
description: Load safe coding workspace context for developer tasks: current workspace, file tree, selected non-secret file previews, and available code-edit/terminal tools.

args_schema.workspace: optional workspace path to inspect; must be inside allowed workspace roots
args_schema.focus_paths: optional array of non-secret files to preview before planning code changes
args_schema.max_files: optional max file tree entries, default 160
args_schema.max_preview_bytes: optional max bytes per focus file preview, default 12000
